interpretation_rule: Assess direction, magnitude, paired bootstrap CI, node-level monotonicity, and corrected Wilcoxon result together; do not base interpretation on p-value alone.

interpretation_rule: Assess explanation-overlap decline specifically among prediction-preserving observations, together with prediction-stability results; do not equate unchanged class with unchanged explanation.
